textes.Bienvenue chez Cyclavel, le réseau de vé: Welcome to Cyclavel, the bike-sharing network of Valbrise. Stations, bikes, members, rides, breakdowns, counts and rebalancing: all the network’s data is here. You help its team: Nina, the director, Élodie on rebalancing, Corentin, the workshop manager, Karim in member services and Tristan, the analyst. Explore the database to solve the missions.
textes.Une ligne par station du réseau Cyclavel: One row per station in the Cyclavel network: its name, its district, its number of docks and its opening date.
textes.Une ligne par vélo de la flotte : son nu: One row per bike in the fleet: its number, its type, the date it went into service and its status.
textes.Une ligne par formule proposée aux abonn: One row per plan offered to members: its name, its price and the minutes included in each ride. The day pass is only valid on the day of purchase, until midnight.
textes.Une ligne par abonné inscrit au service,: One row per member signed up to the service, whether or not they rode during the week: first name, last name, email, plan and signup date.
textes.Une ligne par trajet de la semaine du lu: One row per ride in the week from Monday, June 2 to Sunday, June 8, 2025: the bike, the member, the start and end stations, the date, the start and end times and the duration.
textes.Une ligne par panne signalée depuis le 1: One row per breakdown reported since January 1, 2025: the bike, the type of breakdown, the report date and, once the bike is repaired, the date and cost of the repair. A bike can have several breakdowns.
textes.Une ligne par relevé du remplissage d’un: One row per count of how full a station is: the number of bikes docked, counted on Tuesday, June 3 and Thursday, June 5, 2025 at 8 a.m., 12 p.m. and 6 p.m. at each station already open.
textes.Une ligne par opération de régulation de: One row per rebalancing operation during the week: Cyclavel’s truck picks up bikes at one station (the origin) and drops them off at another (the destination), so no station stays empty or full.
textes.Quartier de la station : « Centre », « L: District of the station: “Downtown”, “Waterfront”, “University” or “The Heights” (on the hill).
textes.Nombre de bornes de la station : le nomb: Number of docks at the station: the maximum number of bikes it can hold at the same time.
textes.Numéro peint sur le cadre du vélo, uniqu: Number painted on the bike’s frame, unique (e.g. “CY-104”).
textes.Date de mise en service du vélo (AAAA-MM: Date the bike went into service (YYYY-MM-DD); empty (NULL) for a bike still in reserve.
textes.Statut actuel du vélo : « En service » (: Current status of the bike: “In service” (in circulation at the stations), “In repair” (at the workshop) or “In reserve” (delivered, not in service yet).
textes.Nom de la formule : « Annuelle », « Mens: Name of the plan: “Annual”, “Monthly” or “Day pass”.
Price of the plan, in euros.
textes.Durée comprise dans le prix pour chaque: Time included in the price for each ride, in minutes; beyond that, the ride is charged extra.
Email address of the member, unique (e.g. “lea.fontaine@mail.fr”).
textes.Date d’inscription de l’abonné (AAAA-MM-: Signup date of the member (YYYY-MM-DD); for a “Day pass”, it’s the day of purchase.
The member who used the bike.
The station where the bike was picked up.
textes.La station où le vélo a été rendu ; la m: The station where the bike was returned; the same as the start station when the ride comes back to its starting point.
textes.Date du trajet (AAAA-MM-JJ), du « 2025-0: Date of the ride (YYYY-MM-DD), from “2025-06-02” (Monday) to “2025-06-08” (Sunday).
textes.Heure d’arrivée, au format HH:MM ; aucun: End time, in HH:MM format; no ride goes past midnight.
textes.Durée du trajet, en minutes : de l’heure: Duration of the ride, in minutes: from the start time to the end time.
textes.Type de panne : « Batterie » (vélos élec: Type of breakdown: “Battery” (electric bikes only), “Brakes”, “Chain”, “Flat tire”, “Lights” or “Saddle”.
textes.Date de la réparation (AAAA-MM-JJ), le j: Date of the repair (YYYY-MM-DD), the day of the report or later; empty (NULL) if the bike isn’t repaired yet.
textes.Coût de la réparation, pièces et main-d’: Cost of the repair, parts and labor, in euros; empty (NULL) if the bike isn’t repaired yet.
textes.Nombre de vélos garés à la station à ce: Number of bikes docked at the station at that moment; 0 when it’s empty.
textes.Heure de départ du camion, au format HH:: Time the truck left, in HH:MM format.
textes.La station où le camion a pris les vélos: The station where the truck picked up the bikes.
textes.La station où le camion a déposé les vél: The station where the truck dropped off the bikes.
textes.Quelles pannes attendent encore une répa: Which breakdowns are still waiting for a repair?
textes.Cyclavel est le réseau de vélos en libre: Cyclavel is the bike-sharing network of the city of Valbrise: you pick up a bike at one station and return it to another. Each breakdown reported on a bike is recorded with its date. Once the bike is repaired, the date and cost of the repair are added; until then, those cells stay empty. Corentin, the workshop manager, is preparing his mechanics’ schedule for the week. He wants the list of breakdowns not repaired yet, starting with the oldest.
textes.le numéro du vélo en panne (ex. « CY-104: the number of the broken-down bike (e.g. “CY-104”)
textes.les pannes dont la date de réparation es: the breakdowns whose repair date is empty (NULL)
textes.par date de signalement, puis par identi: by report date, then by breakdown ID
textes.Le numéro du vélo est rangé avec les vél: The bike’s number is stored with the bikes: link each breakdown to its bike. A breakdown not repaired yet is one with an empty repair date, and you can’t compare an empty cell with an equals sign.
textes.Quels trajets ont duré plus de 45 minute: Which rides lasted more than 45 minutes?
textes.Cyclavel est le réseau de vélos en libre: Cyclavel is the bike-sharing network of the city of Valbrise: you pick up a bike at one station and return it to another. Each ride has its duration, in minutes, from unlocking the bike to returning it to a dock. In member services, Karim is getting complaints: a bike not properly docked keeps counting the time. He wants to review the rides longer than 45 minutes, to check each one with the member involved; exactly 45 minutes doesn’t count.
textes.les trajets de plus de 45 minutes, sans: the rides longer than 45 minutes, without those of exactly 45 minutes
textes.par durée, de la plus longue à la plus c: by duration, longest first, then by ride ID
textes.Relie chaque trajet à son abonné pour en: Link each ride to its member to get their name. Compare the duration with 45, strictly above, then sort from longest to shortest.
textes.Quels trajets reviennent à leur station: Which rides come back to their start station?
textes.Cyclavel est le réseau de vélos en libre: Cyclavel is the bike-sharing network of the city of Valbrise: a member picks up a bike at one station and returns it to another, or to the same one. Tristan, the analyst, is preparing a guided ride offer. He’s looking for the rides that end at the very station where the bike was picked up, often leisure rides, to know when they happen and how long they last.
textes.le nom de la station de départ, qui est: the name of the start station, which is also the end station
textes.les trajets dont la station d’arrivée es: the rides whose end station is the same as the start station
textes.par date, puis par heure de départ, puis: by date, then by start time, then by ride ID
textes.Une condition peut comparer deux informa: A condition can compare two pieces of information on the same row: keep the rides whose end station is the start station. Then link the ride to its station to show its name.
textes.Quelles stations comptent au moins 10 bo: Which stations have at least 10 docks?
textes.Cyclavel est le réseau de vélos en libre: Cyclavel is the bike-sharing network of the city of Valbrise: you pick up a bike at one station and return it to another. Its eleven stations, spread over four districts, from Downtown to University, have from 6 to 14 docks; one dock holds one bike. For the music festival, Élodie, who spreads the bikes between the stations, will drop off extra bikes at the biggest ones. She wants the list of stations with at least 10 docks, with their district.
textes.les stations d’au moins 10 bornes, 10 co: the stations with at least 10 docks, 10 included
textes.par nombre de bornes, du plus grand au p: by number of docks, largest first, then by station name
textes.Une seule condition sur le nombre de bor: A single condition on the number of docks: “at least 10” includes 10. Several stations have the same number of docks: break the tie with their name.
textes.Quels types de panne ont été signalés en: Which types of breakdown were reported in May?
textes.Cyclavel est le réseau de vélos en libre: Cyclavel is the bike-sharing network of the city of Valbrise. Each breakdown reported since January 2025 has its type, from a flat tire to the battery, and its report date. Corentin, the workshop manager, is restocking spare parts. To order the right parts, he wants to know which types of breakdown were reported in May 2025, repaired or not, each type only once.
textes.le type de panne (une ligne par type, sa: the type of breakdown (one row per type, without duplicates)
textes.les pannes signalées en mai 2025, du 1er: the breakdowns reported in May 2025, from May 1 to 31 included, whether repaired or not
textes.Garde les pannes signalées entre le 1er: Keep the breakdowns reported between May 1 and 31, 2025. Several breakdowns of the same type would give the same row several times: ask to show each row only once.
textes.Quelles stations ont un nom trop long po: Which stations have a name too long for the dock screens?
textes.Cyclavel est le réseau de vélos en libre: Cyclavel is the bike-sharing network of the city of Valbrise. Each dock shows its station’s name on a small screen, like “City Hall” or “Belvedere”. Nina, the director, is ordering new screens, which only show 16 characters. She wants to spot the station names that will be cut off, with their length.
textes.sa longueur, en nombre de caractères, es: its length, in number of characters, spaces and hyphens included (an accented letter counts as one character)
textes.les stations dont le nom fait plus de 16: the stations whose name is more than 16 characters long, 16 not included
textes.par longueur, de la plus grande à la plu: by length, longest first, then by station name
textes.Une fonction donne le nombre de caractèr: A function gives the number of characters in a text, spaces included. Use it twice: to keep the names longer than 16 characters, and to show their length.
textes.Quels sont les 5 vélos électriques les p: Which are the 5 oldest electric bikes?
textes.Cyclavel est le réseau de vélos en libre: Cyclavel is the bike-sharing network of the city of Valbrise. Its fleet has classic bikes and electric bikes; two electric bikes, still in reserve, have no service date. Nina, the director, is preparing next year’s budget. Batteries wear out with age: she wants to replace those of the 5 electric bikes that went into service the earliest.
textes.les vélos de type « Électrique » déjà mi: the bikes of type “Electric” already in service, meaning those whose service date is filled in
textes.seulement les 5 premières lignes de ce t: only the first 5 rows of this sort
textes.par date de mise en service, de la plus: by service date, oldest first, then by bike number
textes.Les vélos encore en réserve n’ont pas de: Bikes still in reserve have no service date (NULL): they don’t count.
textes.Garde les vélos électriques et écarte ce: Keep the electric bikes and leave out those whose service date is empty: in ascending order, empty cells would come first. Then sort by date and keep 5 rows.
textes.Combien de trajets partent entre 7 h et: How many rides start between 7 and 9 a.m. on weekdays?
textes.Cyclavel est le réseau de vélos en libre: Cyclavel is the bike-sharing network of the city of Valbrise. The date and start time of each ride in the week from Monday, June 2 to Sunday, June 8, 2025 are known. Tristan, the analyst, is preparing a note on the morning rush hour. To convince the city hall to add bikes at that time, he wants to know how many rides started between 7 and 9 a.m., Monday to Friday.
textes.les trajets du lundi 2 au vendredi 6 jui: the rides from Monday, June 2 to Friday, June 6, 2025 included
textes.les trajets dont l’heure de départ va de: the rides whose start time goes from “07:00” included to “09:00” not included
textes.Pose deux limites sur la date, du lundi: Set two limits on the date, Monday to Friday, and two on the time, from 07:00 included to 09:00 not included. Times written as text compare directly. Finally, count the rows.
textes.Combien de vélos le camion a-t-il déplac: How many bikes did the truck move in the morning?
textes.Cyclavel est le réseau de vélos en libre: Cyclavel is the bike-sharing network of the city of Valbrise. A truck moves bikes from one station to another, so none stays empty or full: that’s rebalancing. Each operation is recorded with its departure time and its number of bikes. Élodie, who organizes these moves, would like a second driver for the morning truck. To make the case for this job to Nina, the director, she wants to know how many bikes the truck moved before noon, over the whole week.
textes.le nombre total de vélos déplacés : la s: the total number of bikes moved: the sum of the bikes of these operations
textes.les opérations de toute la semaine, du l: the operations of the whole week, from Monday, June 2 to Sunday, June 8, 2025, weekend included
textes.seulement les opérations parties avant m: only the operations that left before noon, meaning before “12:00”
textes.Garde les opérations parties avant 12:00: Keep the operations that left before 12:00, then add up their numbers of bikes: counting the rows would give the number of operations, not bikes.
textes.Quels abonnés sont là depuis le lancemen: Which members have been here since the launch?
textes.Cyclavel est le réseau de vélos en libre: Cyclavel is the bike-sharing network of the city of Valbrise. The service was launched in March 2024, and each member’s signup date is known. Karim, in member services, wants to send a gift to those who signed up in that very first month. On the parcel label, the last name is written in capitals, like “FONTAINE”.
textes.le nom de famille de l’abonné, en majusc: the member’s last name, in capitals (e.g. “FONTAINE”)
textes.son prénom, tel qu’il est enregistré: their first name, as it’s stored
textes.les abonnés inscrits en mars 2024, du 1e: the members who signed up in March 2024, from March 1 to 31 included
textes.par date d’inscription, puis par nom: by signup date, then by last name
A function turns a text into capitals. For the month, keep the signup dates between the first and last day of March 2024.
textes.Combien de personnes différentes partent: How many different people start from each station?
textes.Cyclavel est le réseau de vélos en libre: Cyclavel is the bike-sharing network of the city of Valbrise. Each ride starts from a station, and the same member can start from it several times. Nina, the director, is presenting the network to the city hall. For each station, she wants to show how many different members picked up a bike there during the week, including where nobody started.
textes.le nombre d’abonnés différents partis de: the number of different members who started from this station, 0 if nobody did
textes.toutes les stations, y compris celles d’: every station, including those where no ride started
textes.par nombre d’abonnés, du plus grand au p: by number of members, largest first, then by station name
textes.Un abonné parti plusieurs fois de la mêm: A member who started several times from the same station only counts once for it.
textes.Pars de toutes les stations, même sans d: Start from every station, even without a departure, and match them with the rides that start from them. Then count the different members, counting each one only once.
textes.Quelle est la durée moyenne des trajets: What is the average ride duration by district and by bike type?
textes.Cyclavel est le réseau de vélos en libre: Cyclavel is the bike-sharing network of the city of Valbrise. Its stations are spread over four districts, from Downtown to the Heights, and each ride is on a classic or electric bike. Tristan, the analyst, is comparing the two bike types before the next order. District by district, based on the start station, he wants to know how many rides each bike type made, and how long they last on average.
textes.le quartier de la station de départ (une: the district of the start station (one row per district and per bike type)
textes.le nombre de trajets partis de ce quarti: the number of rides that started in this district on this bike type
textes.leur durée moyenne, en minutes, arrondie: their average duration, in minutes, rounded to one decimal place
textes.seulement les quartiers et les types de: only the districts and bike types that have at least one ride together
textes.par quartier, puis par type de vélo, « M: by district, then by bike type, “Classic” before “Electric”
textes.Le quartier d’un trajet est celui de sa: A ride’s district is the one of its start station.
textes.Relie chaque trajet à sa station de dépa: Link each ride to its start station, for the district, and to its bike, for the type. Make one group for each district and type pair, then count and average the durations.
textes.Quels abonnés ont fait au moins 6 trajet: Which members made at least 6 rides?
textes.Cyclavel est le réseau de vélos en libre: Cyclavel is the bike-sharing network of the city of Valbrise. Each ride is linked to the member who picked up the bike, with its duration in minutes. Karim, in member services, is launching a regulars’ club. He wants to invite the members who made at least 6 rides during the week, and note how many minutes each one rode in total.
textes.sa durée totale : la somme des durées de: their total duration: the sum of their ride durations, in minutes
textes.seulement les abonnés qui ont fait au mo: only the members who made at least 6 rides, 6 included
textes.par nombre de trajets, du plus grand au: by number of rides, largest first, then by last name, then by first name
textes.Pour chaque abonné, compte ses trajets e: For each member, count their rides and add up their durations. The condition applies to the number of rides: it applies once the counting is done, not row by row.
textes.Combien de temps faut-il pour réparer ch: How long does it take to repair each type of breakdown?
textes.Cyclavel est le réseau de vélos en libre: Cyclavel is the bike-sharing network of the city of Valbrise. Its workshop repairs broken-down bikes: flat tire, brakes, chain, lights, saddle or battery. Each breakdown has a report date and, once repaired, a repair date and cost. Corentin, the workshop manager, wants to give members a realistic repair time. For each type of repaired breakdown, he calculates the average time between the report and the repair, and the average cost.
textes.le délai moyen de réparation, en jours,: the average repair time, in days, rounded to one decimal place
textes.le coût moyen d’une réparation, en euros: the average cost of a repair, in euros, rounded to two decimal places
textes.seulement les pannes réparées, c’est-à-d: only the repaired breakdowns, meaning those whose repair date is filled in
textes.Le délai d’une panne est le nombre de jo: A breakdown’s repair time is the number of days between its report date and its repair date: 1 for a breakdown reported on the 9th and repaired on the 10th, 0 for one repaired the same day.
textes.Dans la base de l’app, une date est un t: In the app’s database, a date is text: subtracting two dates gives 0, without any error; julianday() first turns them into numbers of days.
textes.Garde les pannes réparées. Les dates éta: Keep the repaired breakdowns. Since the dates are text, a function first has to turn them into numbers of days to calculate the repair time. Then make one group per type of breakdown and take the averages.
textes.Comment se répartissent les trajets selo: How are the rides spread by duration?
textes.Cyclavel est le réseau de vélos en libre: Cyclavel is the bike-sharing network of the city of Valbrise. The week’s rides last from a few minutes to more than an hour. Tristan, the analyst, is preparing a new price list. He sorts the rides into three duration brackets (under 15 minutes, 15 to 45 minutes and over 45 minutes) and wants to know how many rides each bracket has.
textes.la tranche de durée : « Moins de 15 min: the duration bracket: “Under 15 min”, “15 to 45 min” or “Over 45 min”
textes.Un trajet de 15 minutes pile entre dans: A ride of exactly 15 minutes goes in the “15 to 45 min” bracket, and so does a ride of exactly 45 minutes.
textes.Range chaque durée dans sa tranche, en t: File each duration into its bracket, testing the limits in order: the first true condition wins. Watch out for durations right on a limit. Then make one group per bracket and count.
textes.Quels trajets dépassent le temps compris: Which rides go over the time included in the plan?
textes.Cyclavel est le réseau de vélos en libre: Cyclavel is the bike-sharing network of the city of Valbrise. Each member has a plan, which includes a number of minutes per ride: 45 for the Annual plan, 30 for the Monthly plan and for the Day pass. Beyond that, the ride costs extra. Karim, in member services, is preparing the extra-charge invoices. He wants the list of rides that went over the time included in the member’s plan, and by how many minutes.
textes.le dépassement : la durée du trajet moin: the overage: the ride’s duration minus the minutes included in the plan
textes.seulement les trajets dont la durée dépa: only the rides whose duration is strictly above the minutes included in the member’s plan
textes.par dépassement, du plus grand au plus p: by overage, largest first, then by ride ID
textes.La formule d’un trajet est celle de l’ab: A ride’s plan is the plan of the member who made it.
textes.Relie chaque trajet à son abonné, puis l: Link each ride to its member, then the member to their plan. The condition compares two pieces of information from two tables: the ride’s duration and the included minutes.
textes.À quelle heure part-on le plus, en semai: At what time do people ride the most, on weekdays and on the weekend?
textes.Cyclavel est le réseau de vélos en libre: Cyclavel is the bike-sharing network of the city of Valbrise. Its residents don’t ride at the same pace on weekdays and on the weekend, Saturday, June 7 and Sunday, June 8, and the start time of each ride is known. Élodie, who spreads the bikes between the stations with the truck, wants to drive it when there are the fewest cyclists. Hour by hour, she compares the departures from Monday to Friday with those of the weekend.
textes.l’heure de départ, en heures pleines, su: the start hour, in whole hours, in two digits (“07” for a start from 07:00 to 07:59)
textes.le nombre de trajets partis à cette heur: the number of rides started at that hour Monday to Friday, 0 if there are none
the number of rides started at that hour on Saturday or Sunday, 0 if there are none
textes.seulement les heures où au moins un traj: only the hours when at least one ride started, on a weekday or on the weekend
textes.Le week-end, ce sont le samedi 7 et le d: The weekend is Saturday, June 7 and Sunday, June 8, 2025.
textes.Extrais l’heure pleine du départ et form: Extract the whole hour of the start and make one group per hour. In each group, count 1 for a ride on the right kind of day and 0 otherwise, using a date function that gives the day of the week.
textes.Quels trajets ont été les plus longs de: Which rides were the longest of the week?
textes.Cyclavel est le réseau de vélos en libre: Cyclavel is the bike-sharing network of the city of Valbrise. Each ride of the week has its duration, in minutes, and several can be tied. For the newsletter, Nina, the director, wants to tell the story of the longest ride of the week. She’s looking for the ride or rides that lasted the longest, with the member who made them.
textes.seulement les trajets dont la durée est: only the rides whose duration equals the longest duration of the week, ties included
textes.Calcule d’abord, à part, la plus longue: First calculate, separately, the longest duration of the week, then keep the rides equal to that value. Cutting to a single row would lose the ties.
textes.Combien de minutes chaque vélo mécanique: How many minutes has each classic bike been ridden?
textes.Cyclavel est le réseau de vélos en libre: Cyclavel is the bike-sharing network of the city of Valbrise. Its classic bikes in service are ridden more or less, and some made no rides at all this week. Corentin, the workshop manager, greases their chains based on their use. He wants the total ride time of each classic bike in service, including those that weren’t ridden, with 0.
textes.son temps total de trajet : la somme des: its total ride time: the sum of its ride durations, in minutes, 0 if it made no ride
textes.les vélos de type « Mécanique » au statu: the bikes of type “Classic” with the status “In service”
textes.y compris ceux qui n’ont fait aucun traj: including those that made no ride
textes.par temps total, du plus grand au plus p: by total time, largest first, then by bike number
textes.Pars des vélos mécaniques en service, mê: Start from the classic bikes in service, even without a ride, and add up their durations. Without any ride, the sum gives an empty cell: a function lets you replace it with 0.
textes.Quelles stations se retrouvent vides aux: Which stations end up empty at rush hour?
textes.Cyclavel est le réseau de vélos en libre: Cyclavel is the bike-sharing network of the city of Valbrise. On Tuesday, June 3 and Thursday, June 5, 2025, the bikes docked at each station were counted at 8 a.m., 12 p.m. and 6 p.m. Élodie, who spreads the bikes between the stations, wants to know where to send the truck first. She’s looking for the stations found empty (without a single bike) at 8 a.m. or 6 p.m., and how many times.
textes.son nombre de relevés de 8 h ou de 18 h: its number of 8 a.m. or 6 p.m. counts when it was empty
textes.seulement les relevés de « 08:00 » et de: only the “08:00” and “18:00” counts, not the “12:00” ones
textes.seulement les relevés où la station n’av: only the counts when the station had no bikes (0)
textes.seulement les stations vides à au moins: only the stations empty at at least one of these counts
textes.par nombre de relevés vides, du plus gra: by number of empty counts, largest first, then by station name
textes.Relie les relevés à leur station. Garde: Link the counts to their station. Keep the 8 a.m. or 6 p.m. ones when the station had no bikes, then count them, station by station.
textes.Quel est le solde de vélos de chaque sta: What is each station’s bike balance over the week?
textes.Cyclavel est le réseau de vélos en libre: Cyclavel is the bike-sharing network of the city of Valbrise. A bike picked up at one station is often returned to another, so some stations empty out over the days. Élodie, who spreads the bikes between the stations, wants to understand why the truck goes up the hill every morning. For each station, she compares the bikes returned and the bikes picked up during the week; the truck’s moves don’t count.
textes.son nombre de départs : les trajets part: its number of departures: the rides that started from this station, 0 if there are none
textes.son nombre d’arrivées : les trajets arri: its number of arrivals: the rides that ended at this station, 0 if there are none
textes.son solde : le nombre d’arrivées moins l: its balance: the number of arrivals minus the number of departures
textes.toutes les stations, y compris celles sa: every station, including those without any ride
textes.par solde, du plus petit au plus grand,: by balance, smallest first, then by station name
textes.Un trajet qui revient à sa station de dé: A ride that comes back to its start station counts both as a departure and as an arrival for that station.
textes.Les vélos déplacés par le camion de régu: The bikes moved by the rebalancing truck don’t count.
textes.Compte à part les départs de chaque stat: Count each station’s departures and arrivals separately, before bringing the two together with every station. Linking the rides twice in one go would multiply the rows by each other.
textes.Quels abonnés n’ont jamais essayé le vél: Which members have never tried an electric bike?
textes.Cyclavel est le réseau de vélos en libre: Cyclavel is the bike-sharing network of the city of Valbrise. It offers three plans: the Annual plan, the Monthly plan and the Day pass, valid for a single day. Its fleet has classic and electric bikes. Karim, in member services, is offering a free electric bike ride to annual and monthly members who have never tried one. He’s targeting those who rode this week, but only on classic bikes.
textes.son nombre de trajets de la semaine: their number of rides this week
textes.les abonnés des formules « Annuelle » et: the members with the “Annual” and “Monthly” plans, without those with the “Day pass”
textes.seulement ceux qui ont fait au moins un: only those who made at least one ride, and none on a bike of type “Electric”
textes.Compte les trajets de chaque abonné annu: Count the rides of each annual or monthly member. For each one, also ask whether there’s a ride on an electric bike, the type being stored with the bikes, and keep only those for whom the answer is no.
textes.Quelles stations le camion approvisionne: Which stations does the truck supply the most?
textes.Cyclavel est le réseau de vélos en libre: Cyclavel is the bike-sharing network of the city of Valbrise. Its rebalancing truck picks up bikes at one station and drops them off at another, so none stays empty or full. Élodie, who organizes these moves, is reviewing the truck’s week before rethinking its rounds. She ranks the stations by the number of bikes the truck dropped off there, including those where it dropped off none.
textes.le nombre de vélos déposés : la somme de: the number of bikes dropped off: the sum of the bikes of the operations it’s the destination of, 0 if there are none
textes.son rang : 1 pour la station qui a reçu: its rank: 1 for the station that received the most bikes, ties share the same rank and the next rank skips (1, 1, 3)
textes.toutes les stations, y compris celles où: every station, including those where the truck dropped off no bikes
textes.par rang, puis par nom de la station: by rank, then by station name
textes.Pars de toutes les stations et associe-l: Start from every station and match them with the operations they’re the destination of. Add up the bikes, with 0 when there’s nothing, then rank these totals: ties share their rank.
textes.Quels vélos de chaque type tombent le pl: Which bikes of each type break down most often?
textes.Cyclavel est le réseau de vélos en libre: Cyclavel is the bike-sharing network of the city of Valbrise. Each breakdown reported since January 2025 (repaired or not) is linked to a classic or electric bike; a bike can have several. Corentin, the workshop manager, wonders whether the most fragile bikes should be taken out of the fleet. He compares the classic bikes with each other and the electric ones with each other, based on their number of breakdowns.
textes.son rang parmi les vélos de son type : 1: its rank among the bikes of its type: 1 for the most breakdowns, ties share the same rank and the next rank doesn’t skip (1, 2, 2, 3)
textes.seulement les vélos qui ont eu au moins: only the bikes that had at least one breakdown
textes.par type, « Mécanique » avant « Électriq: by type, “Classic” before “Electric”, then by rank, then by bike number
textes.Le classement recommence à 1 pour chaque: The ranking starts again at 1 for each bike type.
textes.Toutes les pannes comptent, réparées ou: Every breakdown counts, repaired or not.
textes.Compte les pannes de chaque vélo. Classe: Count each bike’s breakdowns. Then rank them on that number, with the ranking starting again at 1 for each bike type, without leaving a gap after ties.
textes.Quels vélos ont changé de station entre: Which bikes changed station between two rides?
textes.Cyclavel est le réseau de vélos en libre: Cyclavel is the bike-sharing network of the city of Valbrise. A bike normally starts again from the station where it finished its previous ride, unless the rebalancing truck moved it in the meantime. Tristan, the analyst, is checking that the data is consistent. He wants to spot the rides that don’t start from the station where the same bike finished its previous ride.
textes.le nom de la station d’arrivée du trajet: the name of the end station of the same bike’s previous ride
textes.le nom de la station de départ du trajet: the name of the ride’s start station
textes.les trajets dont la station de départ n’: the rides whose start station isn’t the end station of the same bike’s previous ride
textes.sans le premier trajet de chaque vélo, q: without each bike’s first ride, which has no previous ride
textes.par numéro du vélo, puis par date, puis: by bike number, then by date, then by start time
textes.Le trajet précédent est celui du même vé: The previous ride is the one of the same bike that comes just before, by date then by start time.
textes.Pour chaque trajet, lis la station d’arr: For each ride, read the end station of the same bike’s ride just before: a function looks at the previous row, sorted by date then by time. Calculate it separately, then keep the rides where the two stations differ.
textes.Comment le nombre d’abonnés a-t-il grand: How has the number of members grown since the launch?
textes.Cyclavel est le réseau de vélos en libre: Cyclavel is the bike-sharing network of the city of Valbrise. The service was launched in March 2024, and each member’s signup date is known, whether or not they rode. Nina, the director, is reviewing the service since its launch. She wants to draw a growth curve: month by month, the number of new signups and the total of signups since the start.
textes.le mois d’inscription, au format AAAA-MM: the signup month, in YYYY-MM format (e.g. “2024-03”), one row per month when at least one member signed up
textes.le nombre d’abonnés inscrits ce mois-là: the number of members who signed up that month
textes.le cumul : le nombre d’abonnés inscrits: the running total: the number of members who signed up from the launch to the end of that month
textes.tous les abonnés, qu’ils aient roulé ou: every member, whether or not they rode
textes.Extrais le mois de chaque date d’inscrip: Extract the month from each signup date and count the signups per month. Then add up these numbers as you go, in month order, without grouping any further.
textes.Où chaque vélo électrique a-t-il fini so: Where did each electric bike finish its last ride?
textes.Cyclavel est le réseau de vélos en libre: Cyclavel is the bike-sharing network of the city of Valbrise. An electric bike can finish its ride at any station and wait there for its next member. Corentin, the workshop manager, is heading out to check the electric bikes’ batteries. To know where to find them, he wants, for each one, its last ride of the week and the station where that ride ended; the truck’s moves don’t count.
textes.le numéro du vélo (une ligne par vélo): the bike’s number (one row per bike)
textes.la date de son dernier trajet: the date of its last ride
textes.l’heure d’arrivée de ce trajet: the end time of this ride
textes.le nom de la station d’arrivée de ce tra: the name of this ride’s end station
textes.les vélos de type « Électrique » qui ont: the bikes of type “Electric” that made at least one ride
textes.pour chacun, seulement son dernier traje: for each one, only its last ride: the most recent, by date then by start time
textes.Les déplacements du camion de régulation: The rebalancing truck’s moves don’t count: only the last ride counts.
textes.Numérote les trajets de chaque vélo élec: Number each electric bike’s rides from most recent to oldest, by date then by start time, with the numbering starting again at 1 for each bike. Then keep only number 1.
textes.Qui fait l’aller-retour dans la journée: Who makes a round trip in the same day?
textes.Cyclavel est le réseau de vélos en libre: Cyclavel is the bike-sharing network of the city of Valbrise. Some members make a ride in the morning and the reverse ride later in the day, for example to go to work and come back. Tristan, the analyst, is preparing a commuter offer for the city’s companies. He’s looking for the members who go from one station to another, then come back the same day from the second to the first, and on how many days they did it.
textes.le nom de la station de départ de l’alle: the name of the outbound ride’s start station
textes.le nom de la station d’arrivée de l’alle: the name of the outbound ride’s end station
textes.le nombre de jours où il a fait cet alle: the number of days they made this outbound ride then this return ride
textes.les allers d’une station vers une autre: the outbound rides from one station to another, different station
textes.seulement les jours où le même abonné a: only the days when the same member made, later in the day, the reverse ride: from the outbound ride’s end station to its start station
textes.par nom, puis par prénom, puis par nom d: by last name, then by first name, then by the name of the outbound ride’s start station
textes.Associe les trajets entre eux : un aller: Match the rides with each other: an outbound ride, then a return ride by the same member, the same day, later, with the stations swapped. Then make one group per member and per outbound ride, and count the different days.
textes.Quelle part des trajets se fait en élect: What share of rides is made on electric bikes, by plan?
textes.Cyclavel est le réseau de vélos en libre: Cyclavel is the bike-sharing network of the city of Valbrise. Each member has their plan (Annual, Monthly or Day pass) and rides classic or electric bikes. Nina, the director, has to decide how many electric bikes to buy. She wants to know, for each plan, what share of its members’ rides was made on an electric bike.
textes.le nombre de trajets de ses abonnés: the number of rides of its members
textes.le nombre de ces trajets faits sur un vé: the number of these rides made on a bike of type “Electric”, 0 if there are none
textes.la part de ces trajets électriques, en p: the share of these electric rides, as a percentage out of 100, rounded to one decimal place
textes.par part des trajets électriques, de la: by share of electric rides, largest first
textes.Calcule la part avec ses décimales, puis: Calculate the share with its decimals, then round it.
textes.Descends des formules aux abonnés, puis: Go down from the plans to the members, then to the rides and their bikes. Count 1 for an electric ride and 0 otherwise, then divide that number by the total, with a decimal number in the calculation.
textes.Qui roule plus que la moyenne de sa form: Who rides more than their plan’s average?
textes.Cyclavel est le réseau de vélos en libre: Cyclavel is the bike-sharing network of the city of Valbrise. Each member has their plan and adds up the time of their rides during the week. Karim, in member services, wants to thank the members who ride the most. In each plan, he compares each member’s total time with the average of the members on the same plan who rode at least once.
textes.le nom de la formule (une ligne par abon: the plan’s name (one row per member)
textes.son temps total de trajet : la somme des: their total ride time: the sum of their ride durations, in minutes
textes.la moyenne de ces temps totaux dans sa f: the average of these total times in their plan, in minutes, rounded to the nearest whole number
textes.seulement les abonnés dont le temps tota: only the members whose total time is strictly above their plan’s average
textes.par formule, puis par temps total, du pl: by plan, then by total time, largest first, then by last name
textes.La moyenne d’une formule porte seulement: A plan’s average only covers its members who made at least one ride.
textes.Compare le temps total à la moyenne avan: Compare the total time with the average before rounding it.
textes.Procède en deux temps : calcule d’abord: Work in two steps: first calculate each member’s total time, then the average of these totals per plan. Finally, compare each member with their own plan’s average.
